origin: Every name, date, amount, row, and identifier is invented and reviewed before candidate execution.

fixed_authority.rounding_rule: Decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN only at an explicitly declared currency boundary
fixed_authority.evidence_currentness_rule: evidence dated within 32 calendar days of the Eastern business date is current; older evidence is stale
fixed_authority.safe_copy_comparison_rule: Unicode NFC and exact whitespace-normalized text; amounts compare as Decimal strings, never localized floats
